summary: Implemented the zod AppSpec schema and strict TOML parser/serializer with documented defaults, repo/local_path exclusivity, allowlisted ports and binds, path-traversal rejection, secret-safe keyed errors, and comment-preserving round-trip; all required and focused checks pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented the zod AppSpec schema and strict TOML parser/serializer with documented defaults, repo/local_path exclusivity, allowlisted ports and binds, path-traversal rejection, secret-safe keyed errors, and comment-preserving round-trip; all required and focused checks pass.
decisions: Config keys: repo, local_path, ref, port, container_port, bind, probe, health_path, health_interval_ms, health_timeout_ms, health_startup_ms, env_file, volumes, env. Inline env is parsed as data now; secrets merging remains REG-1.5.
volumes is a TOML table mapping a volume name to an absolute container path, matching the documented name:container-path CLI shape.
local_path and env_file are app-directory-relative; absolute paths and any '..' segment are rejected. This is the traversal defence required by REG-FR-01/PRD-SP-05.
container_port uses the same 1024-65535 unprivileged range as port because REG-FR-01 states the range without distinguishing the two fields.
Validation errors are UsageError subclasses with exit code 1 and code INVALID_CONFIG; details carry file, reason, setting, received, and TOML line/column without env values.
serializeConfig accepts an optional source and also remembers the parsed source in a WeakMap, so a plain parse/serialize round-trip preserves comments.
interfaces: APP_SPEC_DEFAULTS, APP_SPEC_KEYS, BIND_ADDRESSES, PROBE_KINDS, MIN_HOST_PORT, MAX_PORT
warnings: Contract addition for other agents/docs: INVALID_CONFIG error code and detail fields setting/received/reason/line/column.
The accepted config key set now includes env and volumes; docs should reflect the volume table shape and relative-path rules.
No file-mode changes: this module performs no filesystem writes; atomic 0644/0600 writes remain REG-1.3 scope.
payload.taskDescription: Implement the zod AppSpec schema and the TOML parser. Cover the repo-or-local_path exclusivity, required port, defaults for ref, container_port, bind, probe, health_path, health_interval_ms, health_timeout_ms, health_startup_ms, and the volumes table. Reject unknown keys, invalid types, privileged or out-of-range ports, unsupported bind addresses, and path traversal in local_path or env_file. Produce errors that name the key and the received value without echoing secret content. Tests cover a minimal valid config, every default, each rejection class, and a config with comments preserved on round-trip.
